_comment: Trust policy for the FDE gate service Lambda execution role. Attach as the role's AssumeRolePolicyDocument (this is NOT a permissions policy -- see gate-lambda-permissions-policy.json for that). The aws:SourceAccount condition pins the role to THIS account, so a Lambda in a different AWS account cannot assume the role that holds the platform's merge authority. There is deliberately no aws:SourceArn condition as there is on the agent runtime trust policy: Lambda's service principal does not reliably populate SourceArn on assume-role for function execution roles, and a condition that silently never matches would break deployment rather than tighten it. Scope the role to one function by not attaching it to a second one. Replace ${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID} at deploy time.
